sources.title: How to Run DeepSeek V4 Flash Locally: Hardware, GGUFs, and Setup
sources.snippet: DeepSeek V4 Flash is an open-weight model designed for coding, agentic, reasoning, and long-context workloads. Its 13B active parameters reduce per-token compute, but all 284B total parameters remain part of the model, so it still requires a fairly beefy machine to run locally — 70-162 GB before runtime and context overhead.
